name: Magnetically latched operating mechanism reference
summary: Identifies an operating mechanism that uses the documented magnetic latching construction.
description: Identifies an operating mechanism that uses the documented magnetic latching construction. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Operating release input” at the input and “Latched mechanism movement” at the output. Coil polarity and energy depend on the equipment.

Use the device schedule for its actual construction, operating duty and ratings. These original functional illustrations describe the named role and do not certify a standard glyph or product footprint. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
